chapters.title: Chapter 1 slice — fill from your book

settlement-arrival.goal: Learn what happened during the attack and what the villagers need.
settlement-arrival.starter: A walled settlement looms through the rain. Villagers eye you warily from barred gates.
choices: Ask the gate guards what they saw
settlement-arrival.guidance: YOUR NOTE: who has authority, what clue points to the next scene. Suggested DC 12–15 persuasion or insight.

breach-investigation.goal: Find physical evidence at the breach or missing-persons site.
breach-investigation.starter: Broken masonry and trampled mud mark where something large struck the wall.
choices: Follow drag marks away from the wall
breach-investigation.guidance: YOUR NOTE: what success reveals (one canon fact). Perception or investigation DC per your table.

raider-skirmish.goal: Drive off the raiding party and stabilize the settlement.
raider-skirmish.starter: Figures scramble from cover — steel flashes in the storm-light.
choices: Hold the line and protect civilians
raider-skirmish.guidance: YOUR NOTE: enemy count and retreat condition. Use SRD stat blocks in monsters[] below.

endingMessage: The immediate threat eases. Deeper mysteries along the frontier still await — continue in your next scene notes.
